description: Labelled profile -> expected-role pairs for the semantic role index. Each case is a questionnaire a real candidate could submit (interests and skills are drawn from config.INTEREST_OPTIONS and config.SKILL_OPTIONS, checked by tests/test_retrieval_eval.py) plus the role(s) the profile means. 'expect' is the set of roles the profile genuinely describes, so recall is measured over all of them; a case counts as a hit when any of them is recalled. The harness splits these labels into keyword-reachable and meaning-only at run time using the matcher's own rule, because the second kind is the only evidence that the vector index is earning its place.

cases.note: The textbook platform profile: containers, Linux, cloud. Two labels, because this catalogue ships both 'Platform & SRE' and 'Platform Engineer' and both describe the profile equally well — demanding one specific one would measure label noise, not recall.
